## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 30. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

Adam Burke frames the hire as a career coming full circle: Lupoi's first crack at being a head coach is with his alma mater, where he was a Golden Bear from 2000-05 and the programme's defensive line coach from 2008-11. He then reaches for a metaphor — looking at Lupoi got him thinking about racehorses and bloodlines — and lists the pedigree: a college coaching career under Jeff Tedford, Steve Sarkisian, Nick Saban and Dan Lanning, plus three seasons in the NFL under Freddie Kitchens, Dan Quinn and Urban Meyer. He grants there is a ton of coaching experience in that list and that the 44-year-old had to pick up a lot of things. His counterweight is stated in the same terms: even well-bred horses don't always work out, and Lupoi, who follows another man who had a lot of good mentors in Justin Wilcox, is another defensive-minded guy at a place that badly needs an injection of offense.
